response.body:
# Description versus design: six live examples

## Voice summary

The sample does not show two different kinds of information cleanly separated by field. Separate design is sometimes a useful compact approach summary, sometimes duplicates a design-heavy description, and in one closed example carries an explicit correction to an obsolete requirement still in description. Empty design does not mean absent design: even the short workflow-integration description specifies sequencing, versions and preservation constraints. One field can retain everything with headings, but consolidation alone will not resolve stale instructions or distinguish plans from proof. A separate design field is a genuine counterexample to the one-field lean when a short current approach/correction helps a reader avoid a much longer brief. No policy decision follows from six examples.

## Sampling and coverage

Read-only examination; no examined records changed. Only this report's run/stage lifecycle was mutated. Native discovery: `br list --all --deferred --exclude-label system --exclude-label busybee-workflow --exclude-label merge --type task --limit 40 --sort updated_at --fields id,title,status,closed_at --json`. Returned 40 of 1,155 matches, offset 0, `has_more:true`; no later page inspected. This is a recently-updated candidate window, not random sampling or a prevalence survey. No closure-time cutoff: closed examples are current closed records in that window (selected closures 24 October 2026, 07:53–10:10 UTC), not a complete history interval.

Excluded workshop/research/consultation jobs by title. Hydrated eight ordinary candidates once each: hv-oeiknq, hv-e3mzbg, hv-g8sqie, hv-hfnrco, hv-0c0wxq.2, hv-wsjtbn, hv-xl72vw, hv-ucy1vx. Selected first unfinished/closed examples in each field-layout stratum (oeiknq/0c0wxq.2 and g8sqie/e3mzbg); added ucy1vx for a different implementation domain and wsjtbn for its explicit correction. Not selected: hfnrco overlaps g8sqie's workflow family; xl72vw would add UI but not the observed correction. These are purposive choices disclosed to avoid presenting favorable cherry-picks as random evidence. Testing work dominates the window and this sample. Response/merge/generated/system records are not examples. No remote refresh, publication exchange, repository edits or historical snapshot queries performed.

All text below is current tracker text, including on closed tasks. No historical snapshots establish what descriptions/designs said before implementation. Hypothetical before/after layouts below are **illustrative, not record edits or historical reconstructions**. Acceptance stays in its dedicated field under both options. Notes/close reasons are tracker-recorded evidence, not independently rerun tests or verified Git history.

## Relevant ancestor context

- hv-0c0wxq, **Reduce test runtime through focused pyramid refactors** (top level): user requests iterative danger/xslow reduction using injected seams and typed fixtures, preserving meaningful assertions/external-tool contracts and landing small bounded iterations. Parent of oeiknq, 0c0wxq.2, e3mzbg and wsjtbn.
- hv-g8sqie → hv-u2c198, **Run focused domain reviews through one workflow** → hv-0c0wxq. Parent authorizes two deliveries: standalone review first, then Land/feature integration; narrow audits and caller synthesis, no snapshot/locking/cache machinery, preserve saved-run compatibility and Bookworm authority. This is essential context for g8sqie's compressed brief.
- hv-ucy1vx → hv-9o3qco, **Support hk and guidance-only manual hook setup in Beeswax** (top level): opt-in hk/manual hook choices preserving user-owned policy/tracker validation; local implementation and verification only, no landing/push/automatic migration. Thus a closed composition child is not proof of a landed feature.

Native parent-child traversals reached these roots; ancestor descriptions were read through native projected ID queries. Our reporting ancestry hv-cye29u → hv-igexmh → hv-2ezek8 expressly reserves policy decisions to ct; this is authorized evidence for that live workshop, not autonomous policy implementation.

## Layout comparison: illustrative lossless mappings

The following are compact renderings, not replacements for the verbatim evidence appendix. “Retain” means the exact substantive material below remains, not that it is silently discarded. Existing acceptance items remain outside both layouts.

| Example | A — brief in description; approach in design | B — one description with headings |
|---|---|---|
| hv-oeiknq | Description: dispatch-projection problem, one-file scope, five-case preservation and ownership context. Design: existing Store-operation Picks, local request map, trusted config, measured setup and no warmup; retain all existing constraints. | `## Brief` same problem/scope/context; `## Current approach` same Picks/map/config/setup details. Reconcile repeated warmup/persistence constraints once without losing them. |
| hv-0c0wxq.2 | Description: hidden-cost problem, one-file scope, retained obligations, deliberate schema-witness loss, authority/reservations and delivery conditions. Design: typed Recipe/Formula fixture mechanics and warmup/parser removals; retain accepted-design references. | `## Brief`, `## Current approach`, `## Coverage tradeoff`, `## Context and delivery` retain those same obligations, references, reservations and measurement caveats. Merge repeated mechanics rather than erase the coverage loss. |
| hv-e3mzbg | Description: interactive-launch problem/scope, all behavioral obligations, ownership/protected worktree and verification/landing constraints. Optional design: typed BeesConfig, explicit defaults, remove hidden warmup; use existing RunRuntime, no new seam. Move these details out of description rather than copy them. | `## Brief`, `## Current approach`, `## Preserved behavior`, `## Context and delivery` retain all four original paragraphs' content and references. No separate design needed to express the actual approach. |
| hv-g8sqie | Description: integrate the accepted review delivery into Land/feature and preserve required paths/acceptance. Design: driver-handled review gates, versions 7.0.0/0.4.0, Bookworm-before-checks, native provenance/synthesis, saved-run preflight and old checkout retention; retain tests/UI/landing instructions. | `## Brief` integration; `## Current approach` identical gate/version/order/preservation choices; `## Verification and delivery` same preflight/chart/live verification and separate landing. This brief is already so short that headings may cost more than they help. |
| hv-ucy1vx | Description: caller/worker boundary, accepted authority, scope, preservation and local-only parent constraint. Design: persisted hk and fixed common hook pair; early tracker-aware preflight, app-only installer, preserved adapter semantics/lock ownership/readiness. Move, do not duplicate. | `## Brief and ownership`, `## Current approach`, `## Verification scope` retain every existing composition constraint and parent restriction. Keep worker-checkpoint blocker distinct from implementation completion. |
| hv-wsjtbn | Description: reporter problem, scoped files, decoder/policy obligations, historical context/reservations/measurement constraints. Design: current typed-policy/decoder approach and explicit accepted 46-case correction with stated coverage loss. Mark old 47-case/configuration-witness instructions as superseded, retaining provenance rather than presenting both as live requirements. | `## Brief`, `## Current approach`, `## Superseded decision`, `## Coverage tradeoff`, `## Context and delivery` retain the same information and correction. One field exposes the conflict in one reading but still requires deliberate reconciliation. |

### Before implementation versus after completion

**Before, A:** keep problem/outcome/scope stable in description; put proposed or accepted approach plus constraints/rationale in design, explicitly naming its decision authority. Small tasks may leave design empty. **Before, B:** same content under Brief/Current approach headings in description. Neither layout may turn an unverified proposal into a checked acceptance outcome. The unfinished oeiknq has baseline measurements in notes; these are not proof the proposed change landed. g8sqie has no supplied notes or completion evidence.

**After, A:** update current design where the approach actually changed; reconcile superseded instructions in description. **After, B:** update Current approach and reconcile superseded headings in the same description. In either case preserve substantive rationale/tradeoffs and use dedicated acceptance plus evidence references for verified outcome; do not paste full logs into the brief or pretend the retained plan proves success. If a short outcome heading is useful, label it *reported verified outcome* and cite its evidence rather than duplicating it throughout both fields.

Concrete after-completion distinctions: Shared reports integrated 68c8259b and acknowledged lost schema-default coverage; interactive launch reports integrated 186da413 and retained six cases/19 assertions; hk composition explicitly reports **no commits/landing** and a separate worker-workflow blocker; reporter's current correction says 46 cases, unlike its older 47-case description. These statements come from close reasons/current fields, not reconstructed pre-implementation texts.

## Verbatim current source fields

Full description and design follow for every selected example. Only targeted evidence excerpts are included; omitted notes/comments/acceptance text are not implied absent. Empty design is explicitly distinguished from empty approach content.

### hv-oeiknq — Remove accidental I/O from dispatch projection tests

Status: **in_progress**. Parent context: hv-0c0wxq.

**Full description**

```text
Scope the next runtime slice to lib/colony/src/dispatch-projection.test.ts and only minimal existing-store consumer typing if needed. The file parses config, opens a real SQLite store only to spread unused methods into a fake, and executes a full unmeasured warmup. Remove hidden warmup rather than relocate it; use trusted typed config and the existing injected operations appropriate to repair/discovery/authority behavior. Preserve all five cases and meaningful ordering, no-fallback and authority-drift assertions. Preserve real persistence tests; no persistence behavior redesign or broad fake framework. Honeybee report hv-6w765c found no current ordinary owner in bounded exact-topic searches; other candidatefiles and active domain-review hv-hfnrco remain separate. User authorizes small bounded landings; no allowance widening.
```

**Full design**

```text
Preserve dispatch/request behavior and Store ownership. Narrow existing consumer store types to their actually consumed operations (a Pick of the concrete store type); use a local in-memory request map and explicit unused launch operations in this test fixture. No new persistence implementation or package. Trusted config object, no runtime schema parse in policy fixture; move per-case setup into measured test bodies and remove warmup. Existing real Store/history contracts remain unchanged. Measure before/after fresh processes and keep all assertions.
```

**Notes excerpt (baseline, not completed outcome)**

```text
Claimed in /Users/ct/dev/projects/hive/.worktrees/codex--test-pyramid-dispatch-projection at main1d259bdc. Before3freshprocessmedian48.577ms, warmedserialcase0.83-1.02ms; othercases0.02-0.49ms. Current module warmup and unmeasuredSQLite initialization mean those case durations omit realcost. /tmp/dispatch-projection-pyramid-before.json.
```

### hv-0c0wxq.2 — Use trusted fixtures in Shared formula tests

Status: **closed**. Parent context: hv-0c0wxq.

**Full description**

```text
Shared formula tests construct trusted fixtures through runtime schemas and explicitly warm schema/template validation before test timing. This conceals initialization cost and repeats parsing that is unrelated to the renderer policies being asserted.

Implement a bounded test-only change in lib/shared/src/bees.test.ts. Accepted Architect design hv-vhf5of (request hv-a0gwwn, run hv-ic61an) specifies typed Recipe/Formula fixtures with explicit defaults, removal of the explicit warmup block and incidental formula parsing inside the native-string case, and removal of the three dedicated schema-default cases. Retain every custom rendering/validation obligation: optional role/direction combinations and actual TOML round-trips, verbatim arguments, mode prefix selection, unavailable variables including optional branches/helper arguments, and executable-only home expansion in both modes. No production, schema, API, dependency, registry or historical matrix changes.

The coverage reduction is deliberate: dedicated runtime witnesses for empty prompt defaults, default/selected kind workflows and incidental omitted-headless parsing disappear. Typed literals do not preserve those witnesses. The unchanged production declarations remain authoritative; do not replace removed cases with vacuous typed-object assertions or relocate warmups. Preserve actual Handlebars/TOML operations and disclose cold costs; they receive no automatic exemption or new allowance.

Ownership/history report hv-b9sv5j (run hv-ld27xz DONE) found no active exact-file implementation in its bounded queries. Relevant evidence: hv-vz2am for classification and accepted coverage decisions, hv-68ta for the resolved explicit-home contract, hv-sbk3s.5 for earlier retained-default rationale now narrowed by the accepted design. Root's timestamped 24-worktree audit is /tmp/shared-bees-pyramid-worktree-audit-current.json; no exact-file dirt was found. Refresh ownership and dirt before editing. Preserve HITL hv-i694, incident hv-1sylid and old worktree reservations.

Current main was 91d45a23 when designed. Reporter iteration hv-wsjtbn is independent and remains in final review; do not overlap or subsume it. Use a separate Honeycomb worktree, review the actual eventual base and land a separate small commit. Record focused, comparative fresh-process and isolated rendering/TOML/validation costs with all slow samples retained. Run strict changed and normal completion checks; preserve meaningful contracts and return any affected timing-gate failure for scoped follow-up rather than chasing green. Caller owns final tracker publication after implementation closure under Land.
```

**Full design**

```text
Apply accepted Architect hv-vhf5of in one test file: typed Recipe/Formula fixtures, remove explicit validation/schema warmups and incidental native-string formula parsing, remove the three dedicated schema-default cases with explicit coverage tradeoff. Preserve all custom rendering, real TOML argument, validation and home-expansion witnesses. Archive hv-vz2am with hv-68ta for the home contract. No production/API/schema/registry changes.
```

**Close reason (implementation evidence, not requirements)**

```text
Integrated68c8259b, exact reviewed one-file diff578ec96c; final Librarianhv-kcn7i3/Reviewerhv-0l043g; full integrated check and strictchanged0,1909tests6297assertions; cleanup verified. Landhv-y4awnw DONE, final responsehv-ggckat. Caller publication follows.
```

### hv-e3mzbg — Use trusted fixtures in interactive launch tests

Status: **closed**. Parent context: hv-0c0wxq.

**Full description**

```text
Interactive launch tests parse a complete TOML configuration fixture and execute a throwaway runKind call before timing, although their RunRuntime already injects loadConfig and process replacement. Replace that incidental setup with a typed BeesConfig fixture and remove the hidden warmup in lib/colony/src/run.test.ts only.

Keep all existing cases and assertions: default launch arguments, fresh attribution and inherited-environment handling, role/empty-role overrides with response guidance, explicit home expansion, missing terminal before config discovery, and unknown kind/harness failure without launch. Supply explicit values for schema-produced fixture defaults; typed data is trusted test input, not proof of unknown-input validation. Do not move warmup work, add a new seam/factory or change production parsing, schemas, dependencies, registry or test IDs. This applies established user intent and the existing injected RunRuntime boundary; no new architectural decision or dedicated coverage deletion is proposed.

Honeybee response hv-tmdk8u (request hv-r99eqh, run hv-djtua7) supplies bounded ownership/history evidence. No separate active exact-test reservation was established. Preserve retained codex--remove-assessment-inactivity worktree: its run.ts dirt removes three obsolete environment fields and is historical rollback residue, not authority for cleanup. Do not copy, undo or touch it. Preserve HITL hv-i694 and incident hv-1sylid. Refresh exact-path dirt before editing. Configuration archive hv-f390zq preserves actual loader/default/error/order and effective validation contracts; launch archive hv-qobsl and hv-s3faw.12 preserve response composition; hv-3x8.7.2.1.2.3 preserves attribution, and hv-68ta explicit home. Return outcome to existing evidence, not a new architecture archive. Original report /tmp/colony-run-pyramid-triage-result.json.

Use a separate Honeycomb worktree from current main. Shared task hv-0c0wxq.2 remains independent and in final review. Measure fresh-process and isolated cold costs honestly; no automatic exemption or claim that all tests satisfy 1ms. Run focused, strict changed and full checks with normal parallelism, then Bookworm/final Librarian/Reviewer and a small landing. Preserve unrelated timing exceptions as bounded evidence under the user's landing instruction. Keep this task open through integration and cleanup; caller final publication follows closure.

```

**Full design**

**Absent** (native value null).

**Close reason (implementation evidence, not requirements)**

```text
Landed186da413 exact parent68c8259b/diff9942, all6cases19assertions retained; typed config and hiddenwarmup removal only. Bookwormhv-aw8j1d Librarianhv-quefc4 Reviewerhv-nrvxg2; Landhv-dir21m DONE; verified synthesis hv-qr77zz. ### hv-wsjtbn — Separate timing policy tests from JUnit decoding
```

Status: **closed**. Parent context: hv-0c0wxq.

**Full description**

```text
The timing reporter tests construct validated allowance data through a module-level parser, explicitly warm the XML/schema path outside test timing, and repeatedly create and parse XML for threshold, allowance and exit-policy behavior. The user requests trusted typed inputs for policy tests and honest cold timing while preserving meaningful boundary coverage.

Implement the accepted local design in Architect response hv-tygpt5 (run hv-2xebfv, request hv-l4kvex). Writable scope is only lib/tooling/src/test-report.ts and lib/tooling/src/test-report.test.ts. Keep the existing inferred Allowances and TestTiming shapes; expose reportTestTimings over trusted passing testcases. Keep the decoder private and preserve its ordering: XML/root/recursive collection, exclusion of failed/error/skipped cases, then attribute validation. Both existing XML-facing functions delegate to the same policy. Preserve seconds, stable sorting, exact thresholds, multipliers, full numeric ID matching, line rendering, native exit and missing-report behavior. No new dependencies, runner changes, registry edits, test selection changes, or history edits.

Move the selected policy cases to numeric typed fixtures. Keep the four real XML SLOW mode-boundary witnesses, nested/entity/source/output contract, ignored cases, unusable reports and missing-report behavior. Replace the single invalid allowance table with one coherent real configuration contract that proves valid numeric-string coercion and blank-justification rejection. Preserve 47 behavioral cases, stable #test-603 and meaningful assertions; remove all module-level parsing/warmup calls. Do not add a broad matrix or test-only parser framework.

Completed ownership lookup hv-es086z (run hv-ex3lam, request hv-bj5pvz) found no active exact-file implementation reservation. Reuse exact architecture archive hv-vz2am, reading its aligned renewal rather than treating its original resolved findings as current. Preserve record-only future migration hv-td5yhn: this task must not migrate timing gates/registry to native deadlines. Preserve HITL hv-i694, permanent incident hv-1sylid and unrelated retained advice.

Additional directly verified scope: /tmp/test-report-pyramid-current-id-matches.json shows ten current unit titles interpolate fixture IDs #test-1/#test-2/#test-3 and inherit DANGER allowances approved for real Beads contracts. This repeats the established title-leak obligation in hv-vz2am. Have Bookworm use descriptive case labels in actual test titles while preserving all fixture strings, assertions and matcher semantics. The seven intentionally approved #test-603 cases remain. Verify actual candidate JUnit names against the unchanged real registry: no borrowed IDs 1/2/3. This is a title correction, not a new policy or allowance.

Current main is 91d45a2354c2bfb64858f7e49ce4ebee9ecf86f2 after request iteration23 landed. Tooling files are unchanged from the design base aef00b6c. Config22 is fully closed/published; request23 is completing native workflow records and final publication. This task is a separate bounded next slice. Recheck exact-file worktree dirt and current native assignment before implementation; prior scan /tmp/test-report-pyramid-worktree-audit.json was empty. Use an isolated Honeycomb worktree.

Baseline audit /tmp/test-report-pyramid-audit.json retains three alternating before/no-XML-warmup runs: 47 tests and 79 assertions pass. The latter still parses allowances at module scope, so it is not a fully cold candidate. Whole-process ranges overlap. Measure final baseline/candidate fresh processes, both real boundary witnesses independently, normal parallelism, full process and per-test times, counts and leaked-ID matches. Aim for 1 ms and report each crossing without averaging it away or weakening genuine contracts. Preserve invalid/slow samples. Run focused tests, strict changed and CPU-queued full check; obtain Bookworm then exact-base Librarian and Reviewer. User permits bounded unrelated timing-only misses during small landings, without changing allowances. Land one separate Conventional Commit, verify integrated checks/cleanup, and return outcomes to hv-vz2am. Tracker publication is the caller checkpoint after closure under Land; the parent goal retains that obligation.

```

**Full design**

```text
Implement Architect hv-tygpt5 within the existing reporter module: private XML decoder, inferred exported Allowances/TestTiming types, one reportTestTimings typed policy entry point; existing XML wrappers delegate without policy changes. Migrate only mapped policy cases, preserve 47 behaviors and genuine XML/configuration witnesses. Remove module-level parsing/warmups. Apply established hv-vz2am title-leak correction to ten actual JUnit names while preserving fixture IDs and seven approved603 cases. Bookworm before final checks, same-thread Librarian then Reviewer. Caller final publication follows closure under Land.
Accepted correction hv-ljnyy2 (run hv-kdlvlz DONE) supersedes only the prior 47-case/configuration-witness requirement: remove the dedicated Zod coercion/blank-justification test and unused import. Retain all owned XML traversal/filter/composition witnesses and typed gate policies. This deliberately loses dedicated schema-wiring/numeric-text/blank-justification regression evidence; real runner registry parsing remains positive consumer smoke, not equivalent rejection coverage. Revised 46 tests/78 assertions verified. Cold XML still exceeds the 1ms aim and has no new allowance; an affected reporter gate failure must return for scoped follow-up, not be treated as unrelated. No production/schema/registry change.
```

**Close reason (implementation evidence, not requirements)**

```text
Integrated/pushed e0852620bd50ef49d39409a3461b921794ac111d, exact approved diff43c24066 from parent91d45a23. Land hv-z83h8l DONE; synthesis hv-k38kc9 verified. Bookworm and Architect child runs DONE; final Librarian hv-0ft4tq and Reviewer hv-1q4drb approved. Integrated1912tests6302assertions+fmt/lint/types pass, strict changed passes; four unrelated timing misses and cold XML >1ms disclosed. Clean synchronized main and source cleanup verified; reviewed source-only adoption exemption. Enclosing caller publishes final tracker checkpoint after this closure.
```

**Acceptance excerpt (current correction)**

```text
- [x] All owned timing-policy and XML decoding/composition obligations remain; apply the explicit hv-ljnyy2 declarative-schema coverage reduction (46 cases), with no hidden warmup, registry change or restored historical matrix.
```

**Evidenced mismatch:** description still says “Preserve 47 behavioral cases” and asks for a real configuration coercion/rejection contract; design explicitly supersedes that with 46 cases and deliberate loss of that dedicated witness. Current acceptance agrees with the correction. This proves conflicting current instructions, not a runtime defect. It is not necessary to infer staleness from old worktree references elsewhere.

## What the examples support — and do not

- Field presence is not semantic separation: all three description-only records contain substantial approach/coordination content; Shared repeats mechanics across fields.
- Separate design can provide a concise current-approach entry point. Reporter is the strongest counterexample to simply removing it: a visible accepted correction lives there and aligns with current acceptance. Deleting design without reconciliation would lose important coverage-loss information.
- A single headed description can retain exactly the same substance and reduce duplicate maintenance, but only if someone consolidates repeated constraints and marks supersession. Merely concatenating fields preserves bloat and contradictions.
- Evidence of completion is separate from either layout. Closed hk composition is local-only, and current closed text cannot establish what a worker originally saw before implementation.
- This sample supports discussing an **optional distinction and explicit maintenance discipline**, not a claim that one layout is universally better, that headings are mandatory, or that either field should be removed. Automation/storage implications and policy choice remain out of scope.
